quest.title: A Misplaced Conch
quest.description: The Fatui team members you've brought back to their senses have all returned to the camp on the central island. You wonder if the Geochanter Bracer named Yakov has regained his wits or not...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Talk to the Fatui at the camp

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Yakov, Yakov... That was your favorite song.

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: So, has Yakov woken up?

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: No, he's still not responding.

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Every time I sing the song, especially when I get to the line "Midsummer passed, flowers faded. You'll sail away someday, but I'll be here, waiting..."

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Every time I got to it, he'd look at me misty-eyed. Why didn't he react at all this time?

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: *sigh*...

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: I made him his favorite soup. It smelled so good that it made my mouth water, but he remained unconscious.

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: I got it, Agafya! Yakov wants his father to come back more than anything else. How about I pretend to be his father?

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Shut it, you. Don't talk to me! I should've never let Yakov go with you!

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: It wasn't my fault, you know. It was that experiment!

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Oh, Yakov. Poor Yakov...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is Yakov still not responding?

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. Well, as you can see, Yakov is still unresponsive.

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: What should we do now? If he goes back to Snezhnaya like this, he'll probably be dismissed from the Fatui...

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: But he's all on his lonesome now. We've got our own duties to perform, so none of us can afford to take care of him. How will he survive if he gets dismissed?

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}. You know how to deal with situations like this, right?

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Please, I'm begging you, just find a way to wake Yakov up!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But...

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: You want intel, right? We can trade! Even classified secrets such as...

response.speaker: Zakhar
response.text: Yes, such as "we Fatui are secretly hunting for mysterious Medaka in the Golden Apple Archipelago"!

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Zakhar...

response.speaker: Zakhar
response.text: Sorry, that's all I can remember.

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: Running errands is what we do. We don't know any classified secrets.

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Just shut up already, Chevka.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, how do you feel about the intel that "the Fatui are secretly hunting mysterious Medaka on Golden Apple Archipelago," {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: It's news to us, at least...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, it's a deal then. We'll help you.

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Thank you so much!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But how do we wake Yakov up, exactly?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #They look like they've been staying at this camp this whole time... {NICKNAME}, why don't we rummage about and see what we can find?

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: So, did you find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it's not exactly a lead, but it has potential.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You explain the function of the conches to the three Fatui...

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Wow, I didn't expect that the conches affected by the strange machine would have such an effect.

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: What you described sounds like what happened when I took Yakov, who feared a dressing down, to find Chevka.

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, I do remember that incident.

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: But that was quite a while back, and... uhh... My memory's still hazy from whatever it was that huge machine did to me.

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: There are supposed to be four conches, though, so there should be <color=#00E1FFFF>three more</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your memory's hazy, yet you know that there are four conches?

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: While regrouping at the camp, we realized that we forgot to bring bowls for soup, so we used conches instead, one for each of us.

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: Before we took off, however, Yakov left his on a box.

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: The rest of us took ours!

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Uh, we thought they were just ordinary shells, so we threw them away after using them...

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Let me think, I had just gotten on the <color=#00E1FFFF>large island to the northwest</color>... Then I finished the soup and tossed the conch into a watery cave.

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: I think I might've left mine on a mountain on <color=#00E1FFFF>the large island to the south</color>...

response.speaker: Zakhar
response.text: Hehe, I threw mine into a well on the <color=#00E1FFFF>large island to the northeast</color>.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You guys sure scattered them everywhere, huh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The northwestern island should be the one from Xinyan's dream, or Broken Isle.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The large island to the south should be Minacious Isle. And as for the northeastern one...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Must be Twinning Isle.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: They were scattered on those three islands.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We have to find all three conches.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, if we find these three conch shells, maybe we'll find a clue to helping Yakov wake up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm? Look at the conch on that crate, {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It feels like we've seen this sorta thing before, haven't we? Let's go have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, looks like those two people are lying on the ground... Are they stargazing?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: To be honest, this image seems a bit weird...

dialogues.speaker: Projection of Zakhar
dialogues.text: Yakov, what did the commander say to you that's got you so down?

dialogues.speaker: Projection of Yakov
dialogues.text: Well, the waves were really choppy, so I slipped and fell while carrying the device. Fortunately, I was quick enough to save it...

dialogues.speaker: Projection of Yakov
dialogues.text: But the commander still gave me an earful and ordered our squad to do signal reception tests. I mean, ugh, that's the toughest job around...

dialogues.speaker: Projection of Zakhar
dialogues.text: Oh come on, don't feel so down. We've done this stuff a hundred times before. Hey, chin up! Go get yourself something to eat!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're pointing towards something high up. Are they looking for something to eat?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, is this conch crooked somehow?

dialogues.speaker: Projection of Chevka
dialogues.text: Well, look who's back. Pfft. Well, at least you didn't wreck the device or anything.

dialogues.speaker: Projection of Yakov
dialogues.text: But...

dialogues.speaker: Projection of Chevka
dialogues.text: Bah, it was just a signal reception test, not the end of the world.

dialogues.speaker: Projection of Agafya
dialogues.text: See? Chevka doesn't mind!

dialogues.speaker: Projection of Yakov
dialogues.text: Well... Guess I'll make preparations. We'll head out later!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, so these conches can record images...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... it does feel like the snippets it gets are all over the place, though. It's like something's missing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's go ask those Fatui, {NICKNAME}.

talks.objective: Collect clues by talking to the Fatui at the camp

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #By the way, {NICKNAME}, we saw strange conch images in all those places they mentioned.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Those three conches we picked up might have something to do with that. We should put them on the box and see!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, the projection is actually at the center of the stage.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are those two doing? One seems to be talking and the other is sitting on the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, Paimon knows! She must have been telling the person sitting on the ground a story before they went to bed. That's the kind of picture this is!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do Fatui listen to bedtime stories too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You never know.

dialogues.speaker: Projection of Yakov
dialogues.text: Agafya, Persikov has ordered us to perform some signal reception tests. Looks like all four of us have to go... Chevka will probably get mad at me.

dialogues.speaker: Projection of Agafya
dialogues.text: Come on, Yakov, orders are orders, and Chevka isn't going to blame you for them!

dialogues.speaker: Projection of Agafya
dialogues.text: ...You know what, if you're that scared, I'll go with you to talk to Chevka, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, so she wasn't telling a story after all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But this snippet just kinda comes outta nowhere. We can't tell what's going on at all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously? That conch just floated up from inside the well...

choices.text: Well, it is being affected by the Mirage...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's pretty amazing. Ooh, look, {NICKNAME}! Someone's bending over... Ah!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Don't move, {NICKNAME}, behind you...!

choices.text: Uhh, should I be very concerned...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, wait, no. It's just the image projected from the conch. It just appeared behind you so suddenly...

response.speaker: Projection of Yakov
response.text: Two signal testing sets...

response.speaker: Projection of Chevka
response.text: You know, I honestly thought that he was in serious trouble this time. Who knew this was just about being assigned slightly more annoying work! So yeah, that was a relief.

response.speaker: Projection of Agafya
response.text: Hah! You should have seen how afraid he was of getting scolded by you. It was almost like watching a little brother cower at the thought of his older brother scolding him. Y'know... do you think he's just afraid of disappointing us?

response.speaker: Projection of Agafya
response.text: I mean, we're just squad-mates... but it does sometimes feel like we're family as well...

response.speaker: Projection of Chevka
response.text: Family, huh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, Paimon gets the feeling that we just eavesdropped on something we really shouldn't have...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: To be honest, these Fatui don't seem all that bad...

choices.text: This isn't the time for pranks, Paimon!
There was probably a pocket of air inside the shell...

talks.objective: Place the misplaced conches in their original places

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm? Look at the conch on that crate, {NICKNAME}. It looks a little familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This conch is unlike any other we've seen on the other islands. It can record images!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe we'll be able to use 'em find clues to waking Yakov!

dialogues.speaker: Chevka

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: I mean, we're just squad-mates... but it does sometimes feel like we're family as well...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: Family, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Yakov
dialogues.text: Family... But I don't have any family now...

dialogues.speaker: Yakov
dialogues.text: My father stayed behind so I could get away and return to Snezhnaya. After confirming that he didn't make it, they sent me that insignia...

dialogues.speaker: Yakov
dialogues.text: But I don't want any accolades or honors. I... I just want my family back. Oh father, why did you leave me behind in this world?

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Yakov.

dialogues.speaker: Yakov
dialogues.text: Ugh, my head hurts... What happened? Why are you here, Agafya? Weren't you in the other squad?

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: The experiment and our mission are both over, Yakov.

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: So it was about "family," huh? Well, at least I was half right!

dialogues.speaker: Yakov
dialogues.text: Why are you all looking at me like that? Did I say something strange?

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: No, we just heard your true feelings, Yakov. By mistake, yes, but still... Family sometimes goes beyond blood, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: Heh, if you ask me, I'd say that family is whoever you feel comfortable breaking bread with, day after day.

dialogues.speaker: Yakov
dialogues.text: I... Oh, I know...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: You can think of me as your father if you want.

dialogues.speaker: Yakov
dialogues.text: Uh, I'll pass. That would be weird...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, there we go! Yakov's regained his wits!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's great news.

dialogues.speaker: Yakov
dialogues.text: ...Wait a minute. I've read about you two in our internal files...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually, Paimon's been meaning to ask...

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Um, it's nothing. There's nothing all that important written there...

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Oh, right, yes! Without their help, you might have been in a coma forever, Yakov!

response.speaker: Yakov
response.text: Well, uh... I don't know what happened, but thank you all the same!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Honestly, there's some stuff that Paimon still wants to know, but whatever. At least we've finished this "errands for intel" trade, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Can't find the conch? If I remember correctly, it should be in a watery cave on the<color=#00E1FFFF>big island to the northwest</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: My conch? Well, I threw it into a well on the <color=#00E1FFFF>great island to the northeast</color>. That was one deep well.

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: I think I might've left that conch of mine on a mountain on <color=#00E1FFFF>the large island to the south</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: Gah. If I knew what those conchs could do, I wouldn't have taken mine out of the camp.

dialogues.speaker: Yakov
dialogues.text: Why... Why did you leave me alone, Father... Why...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (He still doesn't seem to be in his right mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Well, that's it. We've told you everything we know. Have you found some way to wake Yakov up?

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Like I told you, I don't know much about it. They were probably just some simple tests, but running all over these islands was just... incredibly tiring.

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Zakhar is an orphan. His parents died of illness long ago, and it is said that he led a difficult life for a long time. He then heard that the Fatui provided free meals, and decided to join them...

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Well, that's my two brothers in the photo, both of whom have devoted their services to Snezhnaya. I've always been proud of them.

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: #*sigh* Oh, what are we going to do about Yakov... Do you have any clues, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Why did you join the Fatui?

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: Why... I joined the Fatui?

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: Well, I did it to help realize the long-cherished wish of Her Royal Highness the Tsaritsa... and to bring more honor to my family. I was raised to fight for the Tsaritsa.

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: *sigh* It seems that Yakov is still delirious...

dialogues.speaker: Yakov
dialogues.text: Why... Why did you leave me alone, Father... Why...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (He still doesn't seem to be in his right mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: Ah... How much longer till Yakov regains his wits?

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: Our instructors taught us that we Fatui are soldiers of Snezhnaya who should stand ready to sacrifice ourselves for a greater cause, and that we should not be too swayed by unnecessary emotions...

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: But we've spent so much time together as a team, day in and day out... I'm not the brightest spark, I know that, but can anyone truly feel nothing at all for their comrades?
